title: How to Use Thrive Automator Recipes with Thrive Apprentice

sections.heading: Recipe 1: Enroll Users in a Course Only After They Pass a Quiz

steps.raw_text: Go to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Automator** and click **+ Add New**.
steps.context: > Thrive Automator and click + Add New

steps.raw_text: Set the **Start Trigger** to **User completes quiz**.
steps.context: User completes quiz

steps.raw_text: Choose the specific quiz from the dropdown.
Add a **Filter** to check that the user's score meets your passing threshold.
steps.context: check that the user's score meets your passing threshold

steps.raw_text: Add an **Action** and select **Grant access to product**.
steps.context: and select Grant access to product

steps.raw_text: Choose the Thrive Apprentice product that contains your course.
Click **Save and Activate** to enable the automation.
steps.context: enable the automation

sections.heading: Recipe 2: Notify Students When New Content Is Unlocked

steps.raw_text: First, ensure your course uses a **Drip Schedule** to release content over time. Configure this under **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Apprentice** > **Courses** > your course > **Drip**.
steps.context: release content over time. Configure this under Thrive Dashboard > Thrive Appren

steps.raw_text: Go to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Automator** and click **+ Add New**.
steps.context: > Thrive Automator and click + Add New

steps.raw_text: Set the **Start Trigger** to **Lesson becomes available**.
steps.context: Lesson becomes available

steps.raw_text: Select the course from the dropdown.
Add an **Action** and choose **Send email notification** or tag the user in your connected autoresponder to trigger a campaign.
steps.context: and choose Send email notification or tag the user in your connected autorespond

steps.raw_text: Customize the email content or tag name.
Click **Save and Activate**.

sections.heading: Recipe 3: Revoke Course Access After a Certain Period

steps.raw_text: Go to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Automator** and click **+ Add New**.
steps.context: > Thrive Automator and click + Add New

steps.raw_text: Set the **Start Trigger** to **User receives access to product**.
steps.context: User receives access to product

steps.raw_text: Select the relevant Thrive Apprentice product.
Add a **Delay** action and set the duration (e.g., 30 days, 90 days).
steps.context: action and set the duration (e.g., 30 days, 90 days)

steps.raw_text: After the delay, add an **Action** and select **Remove access from product**.
steps.context: and select Remove access from product

steps.raw_text: Choose the same product you selected in the trigger.
Click **Save and Activate**.

sections.heading: Recipe 4: Grant Access to Multiple Free Courses at Once

steps.raw_text: Go to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Automator** and click **+ Add New**.
steps.context: > Thrive Automator and click + Add New

steps.raw_text: Set the **Start Trigger** to **User registers** (or another trigger that fits your workflow).
steps.context: User registers (or another trigger that fits your workflow)

steps.raw_text: Add an **Action** and select **Grant access to product**. Choose your first free course product.
steps.context: and select Grant access to product. Choose your first free course product

steps.raw_text: Click **+ Add another action** and select **Grant access to product** again. Choose your second free course product.
steps.context: and select Grant access to product again. Choose your second free course product

steps.raw_text: Repeat for each additional free course you want to include.
Click **Save and Activate**.

sections.heading: Recipe 5: Unlock a Premium Lesson When a User Completes a Free Course

steps.raw_text: Create a premium course with its first lesson accessible and remaining content locked behind a purchase.
Go to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Automator** and click **+ Add New**.
steps.context: > Thrive Automator and click + Add New

steps.raw_text: Set the **Start Trigger** to **User completes course**.
steps.context: User completes course

steps.raw_text: Select the free course from the dropdown.
Add an **Action** and select **Grant access to product**.
steps.context: and select Grant access to product

steps.raw_text: Choose the premium course product. Configure it so the user receives access only to the introductory content.
Click **Save and Activate**.

sections.heading: Recipe 6: Remove Users from a Premium Course After a Free Trial Expires

steps.raw_text: Go to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Automator** and click **+ Add New**.
steps.context: > Thrive Automator and click + Add New

steps.raw_text: Set the **Start Trigger** to **User receives access to product**.
steps.context: User receives access to product

steps.raw_text: Select the premium course product you're offering as a trial.
Add a **Delay** action and specify the trial duration (e.g., 7 days, 14 days).
steps.context: action and specify the trial duration (e.g., 7 days, 14 days)

steps.raw_text: After the delay, add an **Action** and select **Remove access from product**.
steps.context: and select Remove access from product

steps.raw_text: Choose the same premium product.
Click **Save and Activate**.

sections.heading: Recipe 7: Send a Thank-You Email After a Course Purchase

steps.raw_text: Go to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Automator** and click **+ Add New**.
steps.context: > Thrive Automator and click + Add New

steps.raw_text: Set the **Start Trigger** to **User purchases product**.
steps.context: User purchases product

steps.raw_text: Select the Thrive Apprentice product from the dropdown.
Add an **Action** and select **Send email notification**.
steps.context: and select Send email notification

steps.raw_text: Write your thank-you message in the email body. Include the course name, login link, and any getting-started instructions.
Click **Save and Activate**.

sections.heading: Recipe 8: Send a Discount Code After a Course Is Purchased

steps.raw_text: Create a discount code in your payment or coupon system for the upsell course.
Set up an email in your autoresponder that contains the discount code and a link to the upsell course sales page.
Go to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Automator** and click **+ Add New**.

steps.raw_text: Set the **Start Trigger** to **User purchases product**.
steps.context: User purchases product

steps.raw_text: Select the Thrive Apprentice product from the dropdown.
Add an **Action** and choose **Tag user in autoresponder**. Select the tag that triggers your discount email campaign.

steps.raw_text: Click **Save and Activate**.
